requirement.description: The skills resource module is missing from the beta resources. Tests are expecting a skills module under beta that implements CRUD operations for skills.
requirement.contract: Implement a skills resource module that provides the following methods: - create(skill_id: str, files: List[bytes], betas: List[str]) -> SkillCreateResponse - retrieve(skill_id: str, betas: List[str]) -> SkillRetrieveResponse - list(limit: int, page: str, source: str, betas: List[str]) -> SyncPageCursor[SkillListResponse] - delete(skill_id: str, betas: List[str]) -> SkillDeleteResponse Additionally implement path parameter validation to raise ValueError for empty string skill_id values.

requirement.description: The skills versions resource module is missing from the beta resources. Tests are expecting a versions module under skills that implements CRUD operations for skill versions.
requirement.contract: Implement a versions resource module that provides the following methods: - create(skill_id: str, files: List[bytes], betas: List[str]) -> VersionCreateResponse - retrieve(version: str, skill_id: str, betas: List[str]) -> VersionRetrieveResponse - list(skill_id: str, limit: int, page: str, betas: List[str]) -> SyncPageCursor[VersionListResponse] - delete(version: str, skill_id: str, betas: List[str]) -> VersionDeleteResponse Additionally implement path parameter validation to raise ValueError for empty string skill_id and version values.

requirement.description: The skills and versions modules are not exported from the beta resource module. Tests are trying to access client.beta.skills.versions but this path doesn't exist.
requirement.contract: Add imports and exports for the skills and versions modules in the beta/__init__.py file to make them accessible via client.beta.skills and client.beta.skills.versions.
requirement.acceptance: tests/api_resources/beta/test_skills.py and tests/api_resources/beta/skills/test_versions.py should be able to import and use the skills and versions modules

requirement.description: The Beta class in beta.py doesn't expose skills and versions properties. The tests expect to access client.beta.skills and client.beta.skills.versions.
requirement.contract: Add skills and versions properties to the Beta and AsyncBeta classes that return Skills and Versions instances respectively.
requirement.acceptance: Tests should be able to access client.beta.skills and client.beta.skills.versions
